cases.sentence: Ежели она и приходила, то только как ___ давно прошедшего.
cases.explain: «приятное воспоминание» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He had heard that the Rostóvs were at Kostromá but the thought of Natásha seldom occurred to him. If it did it was only as a pleasant memory of the distant past. He felt himself not only free from social obligations but also from that feeling which, it seemed to him, he had aroused in himself.

cases.explain: «житейских условий» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.

cases.sentence: «Неужели он умер в том ___, в котором он был тогда?
cases.explain: «злобном настроении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Is it possible that he died in the bitter frame of mind he was then in? Is it possible that the meaning of life was not disclosed to him before he died?” thought Pierre. He recalled Karatáev and his death and involuntarily began to compare these two men, so different, and yet so similar in that they had both lived and both died and in the love he felt for both of them.

cases.sentence: В самом серьезном расположении духа Пьер подъехал к дому ___.
cases.explain: «старого князя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Pierre drove up to the house of the old prince in a most serious mood. The house had escaped the fire; it showed signs of damage but its general aspect was unchanged. The old footman, who met Pierre with a stern face as if wishing to make the visitor feel that the absence of the old prince had not disturbed the order of things in the house, informed him that the princess had gone to her own apartments, and that she received on Sundays.

cases.sentence: Это было единственное ___, которое мы получили с давнего времени.
cases.explain: «радостное известие» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “I was so glad to hear of your safety. It was the first piece of good news we had received for a long time.” Again the princess glanced round at her companion with even more uneasiness in her manner and was about to add something, but Pierre interrupted her.

cases.sentence: Пьер взглянул еще раз на бледное, тонкое, с черными глазами и ___, лицо компаньонки.

cases.translation: Pierre looked again at the companion’s pale, delicate face with its black eyes and peculiar mouth, and something near to him, long forgotten and more than sweet, looked at him from those attentive eyes.
